scope.workers_justification: worker is the sole projection driver: only it sees pass boundaries where no txn is open (WalGovernor.checkpoint MUST run outside txns; nothing invoked it on the drain path, hence checkpoint starvation), owns batch pacing (tight backfill loop otherwise starves writers), and owns the relocated change-log prune (off the query path). No other file can place these.

root_cause.measured: post-edit corpus grouping flips from a ~30ms fold into a full O(corpus) recompute INSIDE one write txn: 2.95s at 4k members (vs 0.031s fold, 100x), ~8s projected at 10k. Any R01 edit/retract cascades a member atom and invalidates the fold digest gate. During the 1/s mutation workload nearly every worker pass paid this, beating the 5s busy_timeout of all 76 concurrent POST /api/ingest (publish BEGIN IMMEDIATE) + 10 reader DDL opens + 1 generation publish = the 87 attempt-2 lock 500s. Log forensics on the persisted attempt-2 server.log confirmed the 76/10/1 split.

keyerror_10.mechanism: hybrid fusion fill by_id[aid] KeyError on atom ids 9987-9994 (recently deleted/rewritten under concurrent mutation): R01 delete commits before its generation publish, plus pooled-view/pin skew across publications; route_pinned re-raises when no generation moved, hence 500.
keyerror_10.fix: tolerant fill in hybrid.search (skip + count via last_fill_skipped); route_pinned retry kept for other sources.

fix.project.py: chunked grouping commits (8 atoms, yields between; R1 amortization kept: 8 calls/pass not 64); drift-aware grouping deferral (pass-count throttle, large-corpus only, deferred reported separately, never failed, no supervisor backoff); throttled coverage heal (per-file DDL always ensured; walk at most every 30s + creation transition; triggers maintain); paced claim loop (5ms/8 jobs); drain-side busy retry (claim retry-then-break, grouping rollback+retry, heal skip-on-busy); per-commit hold telemetry (txn_hold_s max/p95/n/n_over_1s) + heal receipts; chunk-scoped grouping errors (earlier chunks keep progress).
fix.app.py: bounded busy retry on idempotent write sections (prepare/publish/retract/generation-publish with rollback); residual busy -> HTTP 503 + Retry-After (ingest/sync/query/dossier/status; never 500 for contention); reader-build busy retry with handle cleanup then 503; S4 seed busy retry (3x, busy-only, fail-fast otherwise); watcher callbacks never die (log + continue); RSS discipline: anyio thread cap 12 (bounds idle-thread reader retention) + size-aware cache-save throttle (small saves immediate, large at most every 120s).
fix.hybrid.py: tolerant fusion fill (skips vanished ids, counts); read-only query warm (DDL ensure guarded by presence check; prune removed from warm path); public prune_atom_delta_log for the write path (worker-owned).
fix.workers.py: maybe_checkpoint at pass boundaries (existing WalGovernor.checkpoint PASSIVE when WAL > 64MB + always prune delta log; never raises; records before/after, busy/log/checkpointed; TRUNCATE deliberately never issued); backfill pacing 5ms; run_once report gains deferred/txn_hold_s/checkpoint (additive; stats/snapshot untouched).
